equity.level_reason: Percentages by family income (% of FPL) and age group are reported and described (decreasing with income in each age group), but values are only set side by side with no computed contrast and no disparity framing.

level_alternative.reason: Income is a social determinant and the monotone income gradient is interpreted, but no difference or ratio is computed, so the side-by-side cap applies.

ses_components: family income as percentage of FPL
